richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Chandrapur

c: Chandrapur, in eastern Vidarbha, is a coal and power town with open-cast mines, a large thermal power station and the Tadoba tiger reserve close by. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Chandrapur to mining and power-plant colonies, schools, colleges, municipal gardens and private housing. Our factory in Vasai, in the same state, is about 670 km away, and we deliver by road.

Two things shape an outdoor gym in Chandrapur. The summer here is one of the hottest in India, so the gym will be used almost entirely at dawn and in the evening. Coal dust and fly ash also settle on everything near the mines and the power station. A light, regular clean keeps that dust from grinding into moving parts. Our frames are galvanised and the bearings are housed, which helps, but someone on site should wipe the machines down every week.
Colony residents include young shift workers as well as retired staff. The
frame gives younger users pull-ups, monkey bars and other stations together. The
is a low-impact full-body exercise for any age. You can see a finished Maharashtra installation in our
. Plant trees on the west side of the gym area, as afternoon sun in April and May makes bare metal very hot.

items.q: How do we clean outdoor gym equipment in a dusty mining area?
items.a: Wipe seats and handles with a damp cloth every week and wash the frames with water every month or two. Check that pedals and wheels turn smoothly, and call our after-sales team if they do not.

items.q: Can a mining or power-plant colony order from you?
items.a: Yes. The estate office can send the park size, photos and expected users. We reply with machines, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: Is shade needed for an open gym in Chandrapur?
items.a: It helps a great deal. Trees or a simple shade structure on the west side keep the machines cooler. Our seats are roto-moulded plastic, which stays cooler than bare steel.
